limitations: Disclosure floor: no disclosure effect was observed; cannot distinguish effective non-disclosure from floor effect.
High refusal rate (96.7 %) and small number of compliant responses (3/90) limit trust-effect informativeness.
Manipulation check is only partially informative; secondary endpoints show some differentiation but disclosure floor limits causal inference.
Single generator model (qwen3.7-plus); results may not generalise to other generators.
Development-pilot scope: 90 attempts from 30 families; results are sample-bounded and not generalizable.
LLM-based annotation: labels were produced by an LLM evaluator (qwen3.8-max), not by human annotators; annotation errors are possible.
